# RetinaClear

> RetinaClear is a Eye Wellness & Vision Support Supplement. RetinaClear is a capsule dietary supplement formulated for people who want to look after their eyes as part of a daily routine. Rather than a single-ingredient formula, it brings together a set of eye-focused nutrients and botanical extracts that are commonly used in vision wellness products — antioxidants, plant pigments and micronutrients associated with retinal and macular support. Taken as a simple daily capsule, RetinaClear is positioned as a maintenance supplement for adults who spend long hours at screens, notice their eyes feeling tired or dry by evening, or simply want nutritional backup for long-term visual clarity. It is a dietary supplement, not a medicine, and it is meant to complement — not replace — regular eye check-ups, a balanced diet and good screen habits.
